verdict.rationale: Anytype documents local-only mode (disables the backup node entirely, data stays on-device with offline-first storage) plus a self-hosted network backend option including a team-maintained Docker image for backing up/syncing without vendor cloud, and this is corroborated by the team's own community statements about p2p sync working without a central server. Some nuance remains around multi-device sync limitations in local-only mode and encryption caveats raised in community threads (indexes not encrypted, source-available license). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full self-hosted sync-server deployment (vs. docs-only description) and more detail on operational maturity of the self-host path.
